note: Alberta Parks campground in the Elkwater townsite, its sites backing onto a mixed-forest valley at the base of a large hill; walking trails lead to the waterfront and the townsite. Pit toilets on the loop; showers, flush toilets and drinking water are year-round at the Lakeview shower house nearby. --Claude
